about.title: About
about.body: I am Jadli Said, an engineering student specializing in Big Data, Data Science, and Artificial Intelligence. Passionate about the world of data and AI, I am currently pursuing my engineering studies to develop strong expertise in massive data processing, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and advanced analytics technologies. I am deeply engaged in exploring the latest innovations in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence, with the ambition of delivering intelligent solutions to today's complex challenges. My goal is to harness the power of data and algorithms to transform information into real added value, whether for businesses or society as a whole. Convinced that the future belongs to those who master data, I am committed to building systems that are more efficient, more intelligent, and more responsible. Curious, rigorous, and passionate, I am constantly seeking new opportunities to innovate, learn, and contribute to high-impact projects. Open to collaborations, professional exchanges, and ambitious project opportunities, I am ready to take on new challenges.
